text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Aurora (enterprise trial) sent a security checklist asking for SSO + SCIM + RBAC details. They want a POC next week. Key asks: SAML IdP metadata, SCIM provisioning endpoint + auth, domain ownership proof, role mapping controls, dedicated vs hosted data residency + pricing. Any blockers?

Maria Gonzales: I can own the commercial thread. Need to confirm pricing diff: Dedicated pool + Private vs Hosted with regional affinity. Also need lead time for Dedicated GPU reservation and whether a 6mo or 12mo commit is required.

Raj Patel: For the POC ops side — Hosted + SCIM sync is fastest. SCIM supports bearer token + TLS 1.2+. We handle SCIM PATCH for group updates. Quick example for their ENG team:
```
POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <scim-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "userName": "jane@aurora.com",
  "active": true,
  "groups": ["redwood-admins"]
}
```
SAML: we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Metadata upload via Console or API (org-admin token). Metadata URL (example): https://console.redwood.com/metadata/aurora.xml

Emma Li: Security notes — we require IdP entityID whitelist + x509 cert. SP metadata must be uploaded through the Console or via an org-admin token (no email attachments). For domain verification we accept either DNS TXT or SAML assertion (org-verified). If they require EU-only data residency that's only guaranteed on Private or dedicated-region Hosted with contractual SLA.

Alex Chen: Aurora also asked about RBAC: can they define custom roles and map IdP groups? They want least-privilege and ability to restrict model access per role.

Raj Patel: Yes — we support IdP group -> role mapping and custom org roles. Route-level ACLs apply to API tokens and keys. Example roles: `viewer`, `model-admin`, `billing-admin`. Note: pinning a model to a Private deployment or using HSM key import requires a Private contract.

Maria Gonzales: For pricing — Dedicated requires a minimum commit (we usually do 12mo for Reserved capacity). Hosted with regional affinity is possible for POC but has a regional surcharge. I will draft three options: (1) Hosted POC (30d, limited SLA), (2) Dedicated trial (1-3mo eval with uplift), (3) Private pilot (legal + SOC review).

ops-bot: /create-scim-test tenant=aurora — created test tenant aurora-scim-1965, creds emailed to Maria.

Emma Li: Two security blockers flagged in the questionnaire: 1) HSM-backed KMS — supported only on Private (BYOK/HSM). 2) SCIM provisioning log retention — default 90 days, can extend to 365 as an add-on. I'll annotate those on the questionnaire and flag for Legal.

Alex Chen: Great. Can someone pull together a short one-pager for the POC scope (SSO metadata steps, SCIM provisioning flow, RBAC mapping examples, domain verification options, and the three pricing paths)? Want to send to Aurora tomorrow AM. cc @Maria Gonzales

Maria Gonzales: On it. I'll draft the one-pager and share a link here by EOD. :thumbsup:
